title: fix(api): preserve option trust during merges
body:
## Problem

API append, prepend, and remove operations reach the option setter as full replacements. This can clear an expression's untrusted flag and allow it to write files, unlike equivalent `:set` operations.

## Solution

Pass replacement status through the option setters so merges preserve the existing value's trust restrictions.
